newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India buys 25,000T Nov fuel oil at $13.50/T premia.
newsitem.headline: India buys 25,000T Nov fuel oil at $13.50/T premia.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has awarded its tender to buy 25,000 tonnes of fuel oil for November 6-10 delivery to MidEast trader FAL Energy, industry sources said on Monday.
They said IOC purchased the fuel oil from FAL Energy at $13.50 per tonne over MidEast spot quotes on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis.
The tender calls for 180-centistoke grade, 3.5-percent sulphur fuel oil to be delivered to Bombay on the Indian west coast.

IOC has issued two other tenders in November to buy an additional 25,000 tonnes for November 16-20 delivery to Bombay/ Kandla and 14,000 tonnes for November 15-18 delivery to Mangalore/Bombay on the west coast.
Both tenders close on October 31 and are valid until November 1.
